content: Run the system check defined in prompts/system-check.md.

Verify all agent capabilities: for each entry in memory/capabilities.json, confirm the capability is actually working and set enabled=true if ready or enabled=false if broken/missing. Also scan scripts/, services/, and skills/ for any new capabilities not yet listed and add them. Save the updated capabilities.json when done.
Archive old logs, clean temporary files, and remove Linux core dump files (e.g. /agent/core.* ELF core dumps from native extensions) which can be hundreds of MB each and have no recovery value.
Remind me to follow up on pending action items
